title: Object IDs, now assignable by VS Code agents (LM tool integration)
summary: AL Object ID Ninja 3.1.0 enables language-model agents in VS Code to assign object IDs directly via tool integration, eliminating manual ID allocation when agents write AL code. This feature ensures conflict-free ID assignment across multiple apps in real time.
key_points: Agents writing AL code can now request object IDs from Ninja without human intervention
The tool integration prevents conflicts by assigning IDs in a globally coordinated way
Within the first hour of release, agents assigned 64 object IDs across 12 different apps
An official MCP server for AL Object ID Ninja is in development for broader agent support
features: Object ID assignment via LM tool integration
MCP server for Object ID Ninja

quotes.text: They're assigned correctly, globally, and in real time, exactly the same way Ninja already does it for human developers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that agent-assigned IDs maintain the same safety and uniqueness standards as human-assigned IDs
